$comment: Minimal one-step workflow (owner's Commit 1, M0-FACT-CONTRACT-V1.md část C, 18.9.2026): classify a single already-ingested attachment artifact in isolation, so the platform/gateway fan-out driver (src/platform/attachment-fanout.ts) can run document.classify once per mail attachment and decide — from THAT instance's own sealed evidence, never a hardcoded conditional — whether invoice.extract is next. Reuses document.classify's exact step shape from mail-intake.v3.json's classify step; input is the attachment's own artifactId (mail-ingest's attachmentArtifactIds[]), not mail-intake's combined ingest step output. Do NOT fold this into mail-intake.v1/v2/v3.json: those stay untouched, this is a separate, narrower flow the driver starts once per attachment, never the mail itself.
